entries.name: agent-skills
entries.description: Operate the @mournerliao/agent-skills CLI to list, install, update, remove, or record the personal capability catalog.

entries.name: commit
entries.description: Write git commit messages that follow the current repository's conventions, with an English subject and Chinese body.

entries.name: mattpocock-skills
entries.author: Matt Pocock
entries.compatibilityNotes: Cursor consumes ~/.agents/skills (Codex global layout). The recipe installs into Claude Code and Codex/agents roots only — not ~/.cursor/skills. --skill * is upstream's published set; unpublished or personal checkout skills stay out of band.
entries.description: Matt Pocock engineering and productivity skills (grill, tdd, triage, and more).

entries.name: impeccable
entries.author: Paul Bakaus
entries.compatibilityNotes: Cursor consumes ~/.agents/skills. Providers are Claude and Codex; do not add a Cursor copy.
entries.description: Design guidance skill and commands for AI coding agents.

entries.name: find-skills
entries.author: Vercel Labs
entries.compatibilityNotes: Upstream targets the open skills ecosystem; prefer the maintained agent-skills skill or delegated catalog recipes when staying inside this library.
entries.recommendation: Use when you want the public skills marketplace discovery skill itself; prefer agent-skills for this repository's catalog, or natively use npx skills.
entries.description: Discover and install agent skills from public registries.
